parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The sort direction. Valid values:

- DESC: descending

- ASC: ascending

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: The end date. The format is yyyy-MM-dd. For example, 2023-03-13.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword. This parameter is used with SearchMode.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language. Valid values: zh, en, and ja.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is 1000. The minimum value is 1.

parameters.name: SearchMode
parameters.description:
The search mode of the keyword. Valid values:

- LIKE: fuzzy search (default)

- EXACT: exact match

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The start date. The format is yyyy-MM-dd. For example, 2023-03-01.

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.description:
The threshold for the number of DNS queries. This parameter filters domain names by query volume.

If you do not specify this parameter, the operation returns domain names with more than zero queries.

If you specify a value less than 0, the operation returns all domain names.

If you specify 0, the operation returns domain names with zero queries.

If you specify a value greater than 0, the operation returns domain names with a query volume up to this value.
